How to Apply

First sign up for your student account with your Gmail and your own password, then submit your application — it goes straight to the college office. Have a clear copy of your 9th class result card ready before you start — and your 10th class result card too, if the board has issued it.

1

Sign up & log in

First of all, sign up: create your student account with your full name, Gmail address, mobile number and a password you choose — then log in with it.

2

Fill in the online form

Enter your personal details, your parents' and guardian's details and contact numbers, and your Matric result — then give your program choices in order of preference. Pressing submit sends your application straight to the college office.

3

Upload your photo & result cards

Upload your passport-size photo and the copy of your 9th class result card in the form, and your 10th class result card too if the board has issued it. If your 10th card is not issued yet, your roll number in the form is enough. The college reviews every application and emails you its decision.

What you need to apply

  • ✓ Student name and father's (parent's) name
  • ✓ Student's own contact number
  • ✓ Guardian's contact number
  • ✓ Passport-size photograph
  • ✓ Copy of your 9th class result card (upload in the form)
  • ✓ 10th class result card — or your 10th class board roll number if the board has not issued it yet

Result cards — what is needed

Upload a copy of your 9th class result card in the form. For 10th class: upload your result card in the form if the board has issued it — if it has not been issued yet, just enter your 10th class board roll number instead, no upload needed. Only Matric documents are needed — nothing from first year or second year.

Online Application Form — Intermediate Admission

Log in with your student account above first, then complete every section in order — personal information, guardian and emergency contacts, your Matric result with a copy of your 9th class result card, and your program choices. On submit, your application — including your account Gmail — goes straight to the college office. Upload your photo and result card copies in the form. The college will email you its decision.

Personal Information

Photo guidelines

  • Recent passport-size photo with a plain light background
  • Face clearly visible, looking straight at the camera
  • No sunglasses, cap or group photo
  • File format: jpg, gif or png — maximum size 1MB
